notes.text: The opening continues a prior sentence: the operation of pi on the unresolved tau/T set has been extended to an action of the unresolved E/Sigma group. The author then says this does not give an interprétation symp. de la T-, leaves that expression unfinished, and writes Arrêtons followed by four points. Symp. is not expanded, and no missing word after T- is supplied.

After a short rule, the circled section 9 is headed Les schémas et Topos fondamentaux dans la théorie. The circled A begins a revised heading: Topos and an accented Étendus/Étendue are struck, Topos is reinserted above, and the live adjective is modulaires. An interlinear formula over barred Q attaches before pour les courbes de genre 0 avec nu points marqués. The source then describes a modular nu-punctured family and uses an intervening T index written 0nu without a comma.

The main paragraph explicitly states that the indicated topos over Q, for nu=0,1,2, n’est pas un étendu. Its given explanation names les schémas d’Isom of an X/S that is fibré projectif de rang 1, with marked sections distinct on each fibre, and uses the singular predicate est lisse de dim rel. 3-nu >0. The plural subject and singular verb are retained exactly. This report describes the page’s assertion; it does not prove it.

The character before sections marquées resembles the numeral 2 but is heavily retouched; both source witnesses read nu. The candidate therefore has an explicit 2/nu alternative rather than a silent normalization. If later comparison confirms a written 2, that source reading should stand even if the surrounding parameter argument suggests nu. The cancelled relation before >0 and the deleted symbol before 0 in the condition remain separately doubtful.

At the bottom, a cancelled word tentatively read Néanmoins is replaced by the interlinear En fait before ce sont les topos. The list is B_GP(1), B_Aff(1), B_Gm, with B_e=e inserted as another entry. GP(1) is the literal two-letter name and argument shown by the ink; no modern identification with PGL or different dimension convention is supplied. The page ends in the words dont les.

The only pagination visible is pencil 26 at the lower left, in an unidentified hand. The circled 9 and A belong to the inked text. There are no geometric diagrams or further independent drawings beyond the short horizontal separator and the insertion calls. Alphabet-only E/Sigma and tau/T comparisons use preferred C readings with against_C false and against_H true, without claiming that an unresolved alternative has been disproved.

Targeted check of the geometric stabilizer dimensions only: over a geometric field an automorphism of the projective line is z -> (az+b)/(cz+d), with ad-bc nonzero and scalar matrices identified, giving dimension 3. Fixing infinity forces c=0 and yields z -> az+b, a nonzero, dimension 2; also fixing 0 forces b=0, giving G_m of dimension 1; also fixing 1 forces a=1, giving the identity. Any ordered distinct triple can be taken to infinity, 0, 1. Thus the dimensions 3-nu for nu=0,1,2 and a trivial stabilizer for three markings fit the surrounding list. This explains the expected variable nu but does not settle the 2-like/nu count glyph, nor license replacing the written GP(1). It is not a proof of the general-base Isom scheme assertions or the non-etendue statement.
